category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027

Abelardo de la Espriella Sworn In as Colombia President

Abelardo de la Espriella was sworn in on 7 August 2026 as the 36th President of Colombia for the 2026–2030 term. He succeeded Gustavo Petro, whose presidency was Colombia ’s first left-wing administration at the national level.

Presidential Office in Colombia

The President of Colombia is the head of state and head of government under the 1991 Constitution of Colombia. The presidential term in Colombia lasts four years, and the office is filled through direct popular election.

2026 Presidential Election

De la Espriella won the runoff election held on 21 June 2026 with 12,960,166 votes, or 49.66 per cent of the vote. His opponent, Iván Cepeda of the Historic Pact, received 48.70 per cent of the vote in the final round.

Inauguration and Oath Ceremony

The inauguration ceremony was held at the USC Arena at Santiago de Cali University in Cali, instead of Bogotá. Senate President and Congress Speaker Honorio Henríquez administered the presidential oath, and De la Espriella later swore in Vice President José Manuel Restrepo.

Important Facts for Exams Colombia is a presidential republic in northern South America. The President of Colombia serves a four-year term under the 1991 Constitution. Gustavo Petro became Colombia’s first left-wing president in 2022. Runoff elections are used in Colombia when no candidate secures a majority in the first round.

Important Facts for Exams

Colombia is a presidential republic in northern South America.

The President of Colombia serves a four-year term under the 1991 Constitution.

Gustavo Petro became Colombia’s first left-wing president in 2022.

Runoff elections are used in Colombia when no candidate secures a majority in the first round.

Policy Positions and Security Assistance

In his inaugural address at the Pichincha Battalion military base, De la Espriella announced a hardline approach against drug trafficking. He also stated that peace talks with armed groups were exhausted and proposed reducing the size of the state by up to 40 per cent.

International Attendance at the Ceremony

King Felipe VI of Spain, Argentine President Javier Milei, Ecuadorian President Daniel Noboa, and FIFA President Gianni Infantino attended the ceremony. Former Colombian presidents, including Juan Manuel Santos, were barred from attending the inauguration.

On 8 August 2026, the United States announced $1 billion in security assistance to Colombia. De la Espriella invited Luis Felipe Yagüé, a 74-year-old farmer and street vendor, as a guest of honour at the inauguration.

title: India Bans New Renewable Projects Near Borders
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027
content:
Home

India Bans New Renewable Projects Near Borders

India’s Ministry of Home Affairs issued national security guidelines on 8 August 2026 for solar, wind and hybrid renewable energy projects near the International Border, the Line of Control and the Line of Actual Control. The rules cover border areas in Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Punjab, Rajasthan, Gujarat, Arunachal Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand, where land-border security concerns apply under central government clearance systems.

Border Security Zones and Clearances

The guidelines impose a blanket ban on new solar, wind and hybrid projects within 1 km of the International Border, the Line of Control and the Line of Actual Control. Areas within 50 km of these borders are classified as sensitive areas, and every proposed project in this zone requires security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs.

Projects proposed within 20 km of the International Border require an additional No Objection Certificate from the Ministry of Defence. Project clearance between 1 km and 50 km of the border is subject to case-by-case assessment under the new security framework.

Project Conditions and Restrictions

All new applications for renewable energy projects in these zones must be submitted to the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy . Developers are barred from employing engineers, staff or labourers from Pakistan, China and Bangladesh without prior permission from the Central government.

The rules also prohibit transfer of project land to any foreign company without prior clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs and the Central government. Developers must bear the cost of mandatory security measures, including anti-drone systems, in the notified border zones.

Existing Projects and Administrative Framework

Existing projects that had already received clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs or the Ministry of Defence before the issue of these guidelines are not required to reapply. The framework places renewable energy projects under a security vetting process that links energy infrastructure with border management.

Important Facts for Exams The International Border is the recognised boundary between India and Pakistan in most sectors. The Line of Control separates Indian-administered and Pakistan-administered areas of Jammu and Kashmir. The Line of Actual Control is the de facto boundary between India and China. The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy is the nodal ministry for renewable energy policy in India.

Important Facts for Exams

The Line of Control separates Indian-administered and Pakistan-administered areas of Jammu and Kashmir.

The Line of Actual Control is the de facto boundary between India and China.

Renewable Energy and Border Infrastructure

Solar power, wind power and hybrid renewable projects are part of India’s non-fossil energy expansion under central and state-level planning. Border-area infrastructure projects in India often require security vetting because of proximity to international frontiers and military installations.

PM Modi Inaugurates Param Pragya Supercomputing Facility at IIT Delhi

The inauguration took place during the 57th Convocation Ceremony of IIT Delhi, where the Prime Minister was the chief guest.

Param Pragya is a high-performance computing facility designed for artificial intelligence , data science, advanced computing, and interdisciplinary research. Supercomputers are computing systems built to process large volumes of data and perform complex calculations at high speed.

The institute conferred degrees on 587 doctoral scholars, and the graduating batches included the first-ever students of B.Des., Executive MBA, M.Sc. in Biological Sciences, and MA in Culture, Society, Thought.

The event was attended by Union Minister of Education Pralhad Joshi, NITI Aayog member Prof. Abhay Karandikar, IIT Delhi Board of Governors Chairperson Harish Salve, and Director Prof. Rangan Banerjee.

HAL Airport Operationalises Satellite-Guided Helicopter Approach

Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) Airport in Bengaluru, Karnataka, became the first airport in India to operationalise the Required Navigation Performance – Category H (RNP CAT H) satellite-guided helicopter approach procedure on 7 August 2026. The precision navigation system was designed and developed by the Airports Authority of India (AAI) and was validated through flight trials by HAL test pilots before approval by the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA).

Required Navigation Performance and Category H

Required Navigation Performance is a performance-based navigation system that uses satellite guidance and onboard avionics to maintain a specified flight path. Category H, or CAT H, is the helicopter-specific classification used for approach and landing procedures at heliports and airports handling rotary-wing aircraft.

Operational Features of the Procedure

The RNP CAT H procedure allows helicopters to follow optimised flight paths with greater positional accuracy than conventional visual approaches. The system is designed for use in adverse weather conditions and in areas with urban obstacles, terrain constraints, and dense air traffic.

The new procedure reduces helicopter landing approach time from about 12 minutes to approximately four minutes. It also supports the nearly 50 helicopter movements recorded daily at Bengaluru airport.

Helicopter Operations and Aviation Safety

Helicopter approach procedures are used for air ambulances, disaster response, corporate travel, and defence missions. Satellite-based approach systems are part of modern civil aviation navigation and are used to improve route predictability and airspace management.

title: Astrobase Unveils India’s First Private 800 kN Rocket Engine
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027
content:
Home

Astrobase Unveils India’s First Private 800 kN Rocket Engine

Bengaluru-based Astrobase Space Technologies unveiled EVEREST on 7 August 2026 as India’s first privately built 80-tonne-class Full-Flow Staged Combustion rocket engine. The engine uses liquid oxygen and liquid methane, produces 800 kilonewtons of thrust, and is designed for reusable medium-lift launch vehicles.

Full-Flow Staged Combustion Engine

Full-Flow Staged Combustion, or FFSC, is a liquid rocket engine cycle in which both propellants pass through preburners before entering the main combustion chamber. The cycle is used in high-performance engines and is associated with higher efficiency and lower thermal stress than simpler engine cycles.

Technical Features of EVEREST

EVEREST has a specific impulse of about 340 seconds and a throttle range from 50% to 110%. The engine is intended for reusable launch systems, where controlled thrust variation is required during ascent, landing, and recovery operations.

Development, Testing and Manufacturing

Astrobase was selected under IN-SPACe’s Technology Adoption Fund on 10 June 2026 for indigenous development of the 800 kN LOX-methane engine. The company completed sub-scale hot-fire tests in September 2025 and turbopump trials in January 2026, while full-scale hot-fire tests were scheduled for later in 2026.

The startup was founded in 2024 by former ISRO propulsion engineer Devakumar Thammisetty and CoinDCX co-founder Neeraj Khandelwal. Its Bengaluru facility covers 46,000 square feet and uses India’s largest industrial metal 3D printer for core components, while its propulsion test facility in Anantapur, Andhra Pradesh, spans 21.5 acres.

Important Facts for Exams Liquid oxygen is commonly written as LOX, and liquid methane is used as a cleaner-burning rocket fuel in several modern launch vehicle designs. Specific impulse is a standard measure of rocket engine efficiency and is expressed in seconds. Thrust is measured in newtons, and 800 kilonewtons equals 800,000 newtons. Reusable launch vehicles are designed to recover and fly again, which requires engine throttling and restart capability.

title: Ashish Yadav Wins India’s Second World U20 Javelin Medal

Ashish Yadav Wins India’s Second World U20 Javelin Medal

Indian athlete Ashish Yadav won the silver medal in the men’s javelin throw at the World Athletics U20 Championships in Eugene, Oregon, in 2026. His best throw measured 74.09 metres, and it came in his third attempt in the final held on 7 August 2026.

World Athletics U20 Championships

The World Athletics U20 Championships is a global track and field competition for athletes under 20 years of age. It is organised by World Athletics and includes events such as sprinting, middle-distance running, jumps, throws, and combined events.

Men’s Javelin Throw

The men’s javelin throw is a field event in athletics in which competitors throw a spear-like implement called a javelin for maximum distance. In international competitions, the men’s javelin weighs 800 grams and measures between 2.6 metres and 2.7 metres in length.

Medal Finish and Final Standings

Jan-Hendrik Heymans of South Africa won the gold medal with a best throw of 80.50 metres on his sixth attempt. Addison James of Dominica won the bronze medal with a throw of 73.89 metres, which was recorded as a national record. India’s other finalist, T. Dharanidharan, finished sixth with a best effort of 72.35 metres.

Important Facts for Exams Neeraj Chopra won gold in the men’s javelin throw at the World Athletics U20 Championships in 2016. Ashish Yadav became the second Indian medallist in the event and the first Indian silver medallist in the men’s U20 javelin throw. The World Athletics U20 Championships was formerly known as the IAAF World Junior Championships. Eugene in Oregon hosted major international athletics events, including World Athletics championships at the Hayward Field venue.

KDEM, GoodWorks Target ₹5,000 Crore GCC Investment

The Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM) and GoodWorks Group signed a Memorandum of Understanding on 6 August 2026 to accelerate the growth of Global Capability Centres (GCCs) in Karnataka. The partnership has set a target of more than ₹5,000 crore in fresh GCC investment commitments and aims to establish 50 new GCCs in the state.

Global Capability Centres in India

Global Capability Centres are offshore units set up by multinational corporations to manage functions such as technology, finance, research, analytics, and operations. India has become a major GCC destination because of its skilled workforce, digital infrastructure, and established technology ecosystem in cities such as Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Chennai, and Gurugram.

Karnataka’s Technology Ecosystem

Karnataka is one of India’s leading technology states and Bengaluru is a major centre for information technology, start-ups, and multinational corporate operations. The state hosts a large concentration of engineering talent, software services firms, and innovation-led enterprises, which supports the expansion of GCCs.

Investment, Jobs and Real Estate

The partnership is projected to generate more than 62,500 direct and indirect jobs. It is also expected to create ₹2,250 crore in annual salaries and absorb 1.25 million square feet of commercial real estate.

GoodWorks Group will use its Sansovi GCC-as-a-Service platform to support multinational corporations in setting up and scaling operations in India. The MoU also includes outreach to North America, Europe, Japan, South Korea, and the Middle East.

Important Facts for Exams Karnataka Digital Economy Mission is a state-backed initiative linked to digital economy promotion in Karnataka. Global Capability Centres are also known as captive centres or global in-house centres in corporate usage. Bengaluru is one of India’s largest hubs for information technology and enterprise services. Commercial real estate demand in GCC expansion often includes office space for technology, finance, and support functions.

title: Odisha Secures ₹43,437 Crore Food Processing Proposals

Odisha Secures ₹43,437 Crore Food Processing Proposals

Odisha received investment proposals worth ₹43,437 crore in the food processing sector on 7 August 2026 during the launch of Odisha Food Pro-2026 in New Delhi. The event was the first sector-specific investment roadshow organised outside Odisha, and it was held in collaboration with the Associated Chambers of Commerce and Industry of India (ASSOCHAM).

Odisha Food Processing Sector

Food processing is an industrial activity that converts agricultural produce into edible or semi-processed products. In India, the sector includes fruits, vegetables, cereals, dairy, meat, fisheries, packaged foods, and beverages.

Investment Proposals and Employment Estimates

The Odisha government signed 27 Memorandums of Understanding (MoUs) worth ₹41,748 crore on the inaugural day of the summit. These MoUs were projected to generate 35,252 employment opportunities. The state also received 12 Investment Intent Forms (IIFs) worth ₹1,689 crore, with an estimated 8,064 jobs.

The combined MoUs and IIFs were estimated to have the potential to generate 43,316 direct and indirect jobs in Odisha. The total investment proposals on the first day were therefore recorded at ₹43,437 crore.

Food Processing Infrastructure and Policy Features

Food processing investment in India usually depends on cold-chain systems, warehousing, quality certification, logistics, and market linkages. Integrated food parks, cluster-based processing units, and export-oriented facilities are common policy instruments used by state governments.

Odisha Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi announced a five-pillar roadmap for the sector. The roadmap covered specialised food clusters, integrated cold-chain networks, food quality certification, MSME and women self-help group integration, and workforce skill development.

India’s Ariha Wins Historic Gold at Aerobic Gymnastics Asian Championships

Indian gymnast Ariha Pangambam of Imphal, Manipur, won India’s first senior gold medal in the individual women’s category at the Aerobic Gymnastics Asian Championships on 7 August 2026. The championship was held in Tagaytay City, Philippines, from 4 August to 7 August 2026 under the sanction of the Asian Gymnastics Union.

Aerobic Gymnastics

Aerobic gymnastics is a competitive gymnastics discipline governed internationally by the Fédération Internationale de Gymnastique. The sport includes routines performed with high-intensity aerobic movements, flexibility, strength, and coordination, and it is judged on artistry, execution, and difficulty.

Championship Format and Scoring

The 2026 Asian Championships brought together more than 400 athletes and officials from 11 countries. Pangambam won the final with a score of 19.100, including 8.650 for artistry, 7.600 for execution, and 2.850 for difficulty.

Indian Participation in Gymnastics

The Gymnastics Federation of India is the national governing body for gymnastics in India. Indian gymnasts have competed in artistic gymnastics, rhythmic gymnastics, trampoline gymnastics, and aerobic gymnastics at national and international levels.

India International Footwear Fair 2026 Opens in New Delhi

The 10th India International Footwear Fair (IIFF) 2026 was held at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, from 6 August to 8 August 2026. The three-day business-to-business exhibition was organised by the India Trade Promotion Organisation (ITPO) under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, in association with the Confederation of Indian Footwear Industries (CIFI).

India’s Footwear Industry

India’s footwear sector employs nearly 4.5 million people. It accounts for about 12% to 13% of global footwear production. India’s share in global footwear exports is around 2%.

Production Linked Incentive Scheme

The Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme is a central government scheme linked to incremental production and sales. In the footwear sector, it is used to support manufacturing capacity, investment, and export-oriented production.

Technical Textiles in Footwear Manufacturing

Technical textiles are fabrics designed for functional use rather than aesthetics. In footwear manufacturing, technical fabrics form over 90% of the material base. These materials are used in components such as uppers, linings, reinforcements, and performance layers.

Important Facts for Exams Bharat Mandapam is a major exhibition and convention venue in New Delhi. ITPO functions under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry. CIFI stands for Confederation of Indian Footwear Industries. India’s footwear exports account for about 2% of the global total.

Bengaluru Police Launch Operation Mukta Against Illegal Immigrants

The Bengaluru City Police launched Operation Mukta on 8 August 2026 to identify and track suspected illegal immigrants across the city. The drive focused on suspected Bangladeshi nationals and involved early-morning raids from around 5:00 AM in multiple localities.

Operation Mukta and police deployment

Operation Mukta was conducted under the direction of the Bengaluru City Police Commissioner. More than 500 police officers and personnel were deployed in the Whitefield division alone, and the operation covered more than 30 locations under six police station limits.

Areas covered and document checks

Police teams searched migrant sheds and checked identity documents such as Aadhaar cards and Voter ID cards in Whitefield, Kadugodi, Marathahalli, Bellandur, Varthur, Mahadevapura, and Electronic City. The drive also covered 15 to 20 locations in the Electronic City area, including Hebbagodi.

Detention and verification process

About 40 suspicious individuals were taken into custody in the Whitefield division for document and background verification. Four detained persons were identified as Bangladeshi nationals staying illegally after foreign documents were recovered during the searches.

Important Facts for Exams The Foreigners Regional Registration Office, or FRRO, handles registration and related procedures for foreigners in India. Aadhaar is a 12-digit unique identity number issued under the Aadhaar Act, 2016. The Voter ID card in India is issued by the Election Commission of India as an Electors Photo Identity Card. Whitefield, Marathahalli, Bellandur, and Electronic City are major technology and residential zones in Bengaluru.

title: Maharashtra disburses loan waiver to 6.2 lakh farmers
category: Current Affairs Today - Latest Current Affairs - 2026-2027

Maharashtra disburses loan waiver to 6.2 lakh farmers

Maharashtra began direct cash transfers under the Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Shetkari Karj-Mafi Yojana on 7 August 2026. The first phase covered more than 6.2 lakh eligible farmer accounts, and the scheme was framed as a farm loan waiver programme for short-term crop loans.

Scheme framework

The waiver covers short-term crop loans up to ₹2 lakh. The eligible loan period runs from 1 April 2019 to 31 March 2025, and the scheme also provides incentive benefits of up to ₹50,000 for regular borrowers who did not default.

Eligibility and exclusion rules

The state identified about 18 lakh to 19 lakh accounts for initial scrutiny. Nearly 12 lakh accounts were sent back to banks for error verification because of duplicate entries, name mismatches, and cases involving deceased owners with untransferred land.

Cooperation Minister Babasaheb Patil stated that 1.40 lakh farmers were excluded from the waiver list. This group included 94,000 income tax payers flagged by the Central Board of Direct Taxes and 46,000 persons with administrative or technical discrepancies.

Implementation process

The Maharashtra government launched the loan waiver framework on 2 June 2026 after a promise in the Mahayuti alliance’s 2024 Assembly election manifesto. A preliminary pilot rollout began on 23 July 2026, with the first 500 verified beneficiaries across six districts.

State data on 6 August 2026 showed that Aadhaar authentication had been completed for 12.10 lakh accounts out of roughly 32 lakh submitted crop loan accounts. The first phase of direct transfers was initiated on 7 August 2026.

Important Facts for Exams The Punyashlok Ahilyadevi Holkar Shetkari Karj-Mafi Yojana is Maharashtra’s farm loan waiver scheme. Short-term crop loans up to ₹2 lakh are covered under the scheme. The eligible loan period is from 1 April 2019 to 31 March 2025. Aadhaar authentication is used in the verification process for beneficiary accounts.

More than 2,000 public representatives, including ministers, Members of Parliament, and Members of the Legislative Assembly, were disqualified from the scheme. Government officials and local body employees were also excluded from participation.
